picks.title: AUTUMN SAFARI CRUISE
picks.why: Recent sightings include white-tailed eagles, spoonbills and avocets; cruise visits otherwise inaccessible harbour channels.
picks.lens_fit: Excellent 600mm reach; fast shutter needed on boat.

picks.title: SIKA DEER RUT
picks.why: Rutting stags in reserve farmland; potential for behaviour and antler portraits from public trails.
picks.lens_fit: Excellent for distant deer without approaching.

picks.title: RED SQUIRREL WALK
picks.why: Autumn foraging red squirrels near the church; guided walks depend on volunteers. Ferry and entry fees apply.
picks.lens_fit: Good for unobtrusive portraits; 600mm can be tight.
